summary: legal checked in 7 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible growth; counsel_required for rights-dependent or monetization-expanding use. Exact decision: keep searchwoot.com private and preview-only, keep Woot outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization, and continue only bounded read-only evidence work. Evidence: Woot documentation proves API access but not commercial/public redistribution rights; current terms restrict product-listing, price, derivative, and data-mining uses; accuracy/freshness, security, measurement, attribution, and owner gates remain incomplete. Fleet compliance is technical-only at 35 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown. Analytics is yellow with permission/collector errors; unavailable telemetry remains unknown, not zero. Amazon evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission that cannot be assigned to a site. Do not claim site revenue, ROI, margin, payback, forecasts, or causal lift. Ordinary growth may continue only if it preserves existing consent, cookie/analytics disclosure, affiliate disclosure, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 remain open. Progress is evidenced by official Woot API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms artifacts, but none closes because field rights, retention, deletion/correction/access workflows, notification consent, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, rollback evidence, and owner disposition remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Do not send outreach or close tasks without direct evidence.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance, storage, caching, display, derivative, alert, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized request. User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics — evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling new tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA coverage, incident handling, and data-subject request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log, vendor, and incident inventory and route counsel-required gaps.

Parked scaffold sites remain blocked for public launch and preview publication. Concrete decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, and preview-only. The required next evidence action is a dated packet for each site covering execution ownership, preview/build evidence, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker by 2026-09-30T17:00Z. Do not publish, deploy, alter DNS, configure analytics, monetize, spend, add dependencies, or enter the queue before the packet and technical, security, measurement, and legal gates are complete.

Maintain containment-only execution for legal scope. Continue existing measurement, repair-or-close, attribution/cost reconciliation, security evidence, launch-readiness evidence, and parked-site verification. Do not create new production work, requeue unchanged failures, add telemetry, add dependencies, deploy, spend, expand monetization, or make unsupported financial or causal claims. Incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary growth, but rights-dependent, public-data, privacy-sensitive, or security-sensitive changes remain blocked or counsel_required until evidenced.

Compliance and disclosure triage: preserve affiliate disclosures, consent and cookie disclosures, privacy and terms, data provenance and rights, claims accuracy, copyright/trademark boundaries, platform-policy limits, and age-sensitive safeguards for all retained work. The compliance scan is a technical baseline, not certification; failures and unknowns require site-specific evidence or remediation when a release depends on them. Analytics and revenue-quality gaps do not independently block ordinary reversible growth, but no site-level revenue, ROI, margin, payback, forecast, or causal-lift claim is supported.

Security and launch evidence remain insufficient for public exposure. Fleet-doctor and operations sweeps have no results, all 59 security sitefacts are unknown, and authentication, secrets, isolation, release, dependency, TLS, data-exposure, monitoring, incident, and disclosure controls are unevidenced. Preserve private launch gates and permit only bounded reversible work that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior.
